notes: Image-projection inputs from GML, ALS and footprints are orthometric unless a caller explicitly passes input_datum=ellipsoidal.
orthometric_geoid_m is a config value, not a code constant. A1 zeta-ls is expected to update this default; 45.7 and 48.0 remain reproducible override values.
A3a changes the image-projection default to the official GCG2016 value 45.700 for orthometric inputs; 3D seed/training paths remain outside this config.
3D seed and training paths already use their own geoid-fixed data and are not controlled by this file.
